profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer focused on backend infrastructure and tooling, primarily working in Node.js and TypeScript. Building distributed workflow orchestration with Temporal, managing infrastructure with Terraform, enhancing observability through DataDog, and creating CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions. Work with SQL and NoSQL databases across various systems. Designed and implemented Temporal workflows to orchestrate cross-regional AWS account migrations, ensuring seamless data transfers. Led broad-reaching improvements to platform reliability and developer experience.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
For SquadJobs:
As the senior full-stack engineer and technical lead, I spearhead all architectural efforts on a ReactJS/ NodeJS stack. I planned and structured the data, application, and observational aspects of the application. I also mentor and coach junior engineers and provide code review feedback. Tech used: Elasticsearch, Postgres, Typescript, Lerna.js, Sequelize, NestJS, Redux, TailwindCSS, Jest, Cypress, etc.

For LWT:
Assist with WordPress sites, data management and analysis, and script algorithms to facilitate actionability of the data. Also, advise on security practices.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack development as part of an AGILE team. All team members functioned as full-cycle engineers, managing every aspect of the application from design to operations. I spearheaded, alongside one of our data warehouse engineers, the data integration of many datasets into a cohesive, usable, resilient, accurate shape for use by our web applications in reporting to upper level leadership. Tooling used: Typescript, NodeJS, NestJS, Angular, Kubernetes, Docker, bash, MongoDB, SQL, ORM, SCSS, Material Design, Carbon Design.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack development as part of an AGILE scrum team writing internal management software. Spearheaded the modernization, simplification, and redesign of the user interface. Contribute using Typescript, AngularJS, .NET, C#, MongoDB, SQL, JSON, Rest API, npm, Node JS, SCSS, and Bootstrap.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked as part of an AGILE scrum team to write internal management software. Contributed to the full stack using technologies such as ASP.NET MVC, C#, MongoDB, SQL, Javascript (AngularJS, TypeScript, jQuery, and plain), and CSS (SCSS, Bootstrap, and custom). I specialized in taking a current design/UI and reworking it to achieve a more pleasant user experience (UX).

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Worked as part of the marketing web team, maintaining and updating the primary college website as well as the many micro-sites affiliated with the institution. Helped transition Classic ASP websites into a custom Wordpress stack. Code responsibilities included full scale front-end web design/development and mid-level back-end web development tasks. Also assisted in social media marketing efforts, promoting college events and information.

positions.title: Web & Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Worked as part of a team to manage medical hiring applications, creating new content through the use of HTML, CSS, Javascript, jQuery, Visual C#, ASP.NET MVC 4, and ColdFusion. Assisted in all design decisions for marketing campaigns, company advertisement, and client emails. Rewrote all front-end code using SMACSS concepts for the CSS portion.

Company Sites:
www.mdjobsite.com, www.pajobsite.com, www.medcruiter.com

positions.title: Web & Graphic Designer
positions.description: Worked with team on design and development of new websites as well as the maintenance and re-design of existing sites. Worked in PHP, SQL, HTML, jQuery, and CSS. Also worked on misc graphic design and desktop publishing projects, including designing the layout and overall look of three 400+ page directories. Assisted with writing, editing, and answering customer calls.
